sources.title: Durable step orchestration
sources.excerpt: Durable workflows should split long-running agent work into retryable, inspectable steps with checkpointed inputs and outputs.
claims: Long-running research agents need durable step boundaries, retry records, and checkpoints to be operable.
Workflow state should be inspectable separately from the final artifact so operators can diagnose stalled or failed runs.

sources.title: Evidence-backed artifacts
sources.excerpt: Claims in generated reports are more useful when they carry citation links to source excerpts and are exported with a machine-readable evidence bundle.
claims: Research output should pair human-readable reports with structured evidence bundles.
Citation metadata makes generated claims auditable after the run completes.

sources.title: Provider routing and policy control
sources.excerpt: Provider selection, tool permissions, budgets, and human approval rules should be explicit runtime policy instead of hidden prompt text.
claims: Provider routing becomes safer when cost, tool permissions, and approval rules are represented as runtime policy.
Policy checks should be recorded with each run so failures and approvals remain traceable.

sources.title: Local runnable development path
sources.excerpt: A platform skeleton is not usable until developers can start it locally, create a run, watch status progress, and download outputs without cloud bindings.
claims: A local API path shortens feedback loops by exercising the same UI contract without requiring production bindings.
Automated smoke tests should prove that a run can progress from creation to completed artifacts.
